message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data and model files are loaded from local pickle files without any checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote source handling.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline uses only imputation, scaling, and encoding with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious input samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized pickle files (data_prepration.pkl, rf.pkl, svr.pkl) directly with no hash check, signature verification, or any integrity validation before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks label distribution, class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor detection mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present in this code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress testing logic is present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code performs inference/prediction only on user-supplied or training data without isolating a held-out test set, hashing evaluation data, or using multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: Inputs are collected via Streamlit widgets with basic UI constraints (min/max on number_input, fixed selectbox options) but there is no explicit programmatic validation, schema check, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The prediction output is directly truncated and formatted as a dollar string with no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds applied to the model's returned value.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular regression model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
